current_evidence: 4L.14 proposes rank association only. 4L.13/4L.14 reviews agree that RFU and biovolume/biomass are different quantities; absolute agreement, calibration and prediction are not estimable. The independent review calls the descriptive rank question coherent but modest.
new_evidence_4l15_and_strategic_reconstr: No 4L.15 package exists in the repository. recommended_decision: Adopt (a) rank association only. Remove relative concordance. Do not add absolute agreement or predictive performance.
suitable_for_human_consideration_now: Yes, subject to review of the 4L.14 addendum

original_wording: (a) supplied biomass; (b) derive biovolume from cell volume x density; (c) exclude Buffalo Pound
current_evidence: Supplied Biomass_mg_m3 is a microscopy-derived wet-weight-equivalent quantity. Local arithmetic is consistent with Cell_Volume x Cell_Density x 10^-6 under a 1 g/cm3 assumption (2018 median 1.000e-6, n=817; 2019 median 1.000e-6, n=405). The Painter 2022 full text is now accessible and verifies microscopy, species identification, cell-volume measurement and shape-based conversion, but not the exact universal multiplier or duplicate-row semantics.
new_evidence_4l15_and_strategic_reconstr: Müggelsee metadata documents a 1 g/cm3 biomass conversion, which supports the general convention but does not verify the Buffalo Pound field. The strategic reconstruction recommends keeping P3/P4 exploratory pending custodian verification. No 4L.15 package exists; the field-study proposal does not resolve Buffalo Pound provenance.
remaining_uncertainty: Exact density multiplier/rounding chain; whether duplicate date-species rows are replicates; detection limits; whether local Biomass_mg_m3 exactly matches the paper method.
recommended_decision: Adopt (a) supplied biomass only conditionally, with P3/P4 downgraded to exploratory. Do not derive a new biovolume endpoint. If the custodian cannot verify provenance/replicates, P3/P4 are not primary.
suitable_for_human_consideration_now: Yes for the conditional decision; final P3/P4 status depends on D-08 and custodian evidence

original_wording: (a) 0.5 m vs 0-8 m, no correction; (b) attempt a depth correction; (c) exclude Mendota
current_evidence: Sensors are at 0.5 m; biology is a 0-8 m tube composite; ~105.7 m spatial offset; station blank for 371/402 dates. No depth-resolved paired profiles at the buoy. No validated correction exists.
new_evidence_4l15_and_strategic_reconstr: Müggelsee has depth-profile data (FRED 165), but that is a different lake and not available for Mendota. The strategic reconstruction confirms Mendota remains a depth-mismatched case study, not a depth comparison.
remaining_uncertainty: How much of any association is due to depth/sample integration vs sensor performance. The design cannot separate them.
recommended_decision: Adopt (a): 0.5 m vs 0-8 m, no correction; frame as a depth-mismatched case-study limitation. No depth-effect or whole-column claim.

current_evidence: Both output RFU but differ by orders of magnitude. 2019 paired medians: Turner chlorophyll 1,354.74 vs YSI 0.39; Turner phycocyanin 802.01 vs YSI 0.59. No cross-calibration. EML documents significant magnitude differences.
new_evidence_4l15_and_strategic_reconstr: Müggelsee also has instrument changes (YSI 6600 to 6600V2-4 to EXO2) and documents them; this reinforces that instrument eras must be separated, not concatenated. No transferable crosswalk exists.
remaining_uncertainty: None for separation; YSI n is small and secondary.
recommended_decision: Adopt (a): separate eras; never concatenate; 2019 transition analysed separately by instrument; no conversion.

original_wording: (a) retain H, exclude C/E/G/O; (b) strict unflagged; (c) include all numeric
current_evidence: 4L.14 provides an exact tree, but several rules are not evidence-based: H retention without documented instrument range; negative RFU as ordinary rank; Buffalo Pound >100 RFU; undocumented flags; B7 overlap unquantified. The independent review calls the system reproducible in parts, not scientifically justified as a whole.
new_evidence_4l15_and_strategic_reconstr: The 4L.14 addendum separates documented from unresolved flags and suspends unsupported bounds. Müggelsee metadata shows how a provider can document methods, but does not validate Mendota or Buffalo Pound QC. The strategic reconstruction confirms these are analysis-population choices, not clean-data claims.
remaining_uncertainty: Instrument-specific meaning of negative/above-range RFU; whether 0-100 is an operating range; B7 overlap with high biomass; negative RFU counts; undocumented flag semantics.
recommended_decision: Adopt the addendum rule: invalid documented flags excluded; H retained only within documented range, otherwise unresolved and excluded primary with sensitivity; negative RFU flagged below-baseline and sensitivity-only; BP >100 excluded primary with sensitivity; undocumented flags unresolved and excluded primary with sensitivity; no imputation; no clean-data claim.
suitable_for_human_consideration_now: Yes for the rule; final application depends on source documentation

original_wording: (a) full-day mean for both lakes; (b) nighttime for BP only; (c) daytime for both
current_evidence: Mendota provider daily means lack within-day counts; Buffalo Pound means are computed from 10-minute data and filtered by coverage. The two are not equivalent exposures. Quenching can reduce chlorophyll and PC signals.
new_evidence_4l15_and_strategic_reconstr: Müggelsee has 5-minute data, but that is future Stage 2 and not current. The strategic reconstruction confirms the current asymmetry cannot be removed.
remaining_uncertainty: Diel bias in Mendota cannot be removed; Buffalo Pound nighttime sensitivity depends on date-specific coverage.
recommended_decision: Adopt (a) full-day mean for both, with Buffalo Pound nighttime/daytime medians as sensitivity and an explicit asymmetry statement. No claim of equivalent daily exposure.

original_wording: (a) same-day primary + +/-1-day sensitivity; (b) +/-3/+/-7/+/-14; (c) same-day only, no sensitivity
current_evidence: Biology is date-only; +/-1 day changes sample composition and can span bloom phases. Wider windows are not defensible for a same-calendar-date question.
new_evidence_4l15_and_strategic_reconstr: The strategic reconstruction confirms Stage 1 is not an onset/lead-time study; wider windows would invite early-warning over-reading. No 4L.15 package exists; the field study would not change this.
remaining_uncertainty: Whether +/-1 day is worth reporting at all. It is exploratory only.
recommended_decision: Adopt (a) revised: same-calendar-date primary; +/-1 day exploratory only; no +/-3/7/14; no lag/lead/onset. Consider dropping +/-1 if reviewers prefer the cleanest design.

original_wording: (a) mean before summing; (b) sum; (c) first row

suitable_for_human_consideration_now: No for final decision; yes to record the requirement and suspend P3/P4

original_wording: (a) Mendota year-cluster bootstrap; BP naive date bootstrap + year separation; (b) p-values; (c) no intervals
current_evidence: 14 non-exchangeable Mendota years; two Buffalo Pound seasons; serial dependence. The optional 2,000-resample season-year block bootstrap lacks a defined target, exchangeability assumptions, sparse-block rules and valid-resample justification.
new_evidence_4l15_and_strategic_reconstr: The addendum removes the block bootstrap entirely and retains leave-one-year-out and leave-one-date-out as influence diagnostics only. The strategic reconstruction confirms no inferential uncertainty is available from these designs.
remaining_uncertainty: No reliable interval for Buffalo Pound; Mendota influence range is descriptive only.
recommended_decision: Adopt revised (a): rho, n, full leave-one-year-out set (Mendota); separate 2018/2019 and leave-one-date-out influence values (BP); no bootstrap, no percentiles, no CI, no p-values.

suitable_for_human_consideration_now: Yes for the principle; the numeric threshold requires the count audit
